title: My luck is 0% today! Do you have these? 😭💔 #roblox #brainrotevolution #robloxshorts #brainrot
description:
Is it just me, or is the luck system broken? 🧸💔 Today I’m opening post-event chests in Roblox Brainrot Evolution and... well, you can see for yourself. 

Nothing but duplicates! 😭 Fragola La La La, Boxo Malino, and so many Man Man Man Sahur... I feel like they are following me! 🍓📦 

Watch my "painful" montage of unlucky pulls. Are you getting these too, or did you actually find something rare? Tell me your worst opening story in the comments! 👇✨

Subscribe to join our cozy hunting squad! Let’s hope for better luck next time! 🏆🎉
